# Zilkworm Documentation

> Stateless Ethereum block execution, proved in a zkVM. Zilkworm compiles a C++ block execution engine to RISC-V guests, and each proof covers one block.

## Home

- [Overview](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/): Zilkworm runs stateless Ethereum block execution in RISC-V zkVM guests and ships provers for Airbender and SP1 Hypercube.

## Provers

- [Choosing a prover](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/provers/choosing-a-prover): Compare the Airbender, Hypercube and ZisK provers and the HashState guest by artifacts, hardware and status.
- [Airbender prover](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/provers/airbender-prover): Run the Airbender GPU prover from its Docker image to execute, prove and verify blocks.
- [Hypercube prover](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/provers/hypercube-prover): Run the SP1 Hypercube prover binary to execute or prove blocks with the MFBD guest.
- [ZisK prover](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/provers/zisk-prover): The ZisK backend lives in draft PR #86 and runs execute-only in CI.
- [Ethproofs posting](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/provers/ethproofs-posting): The Airbender and Hypercube services report queued, proving and proved blocks to Ethproofs when given three flags.

## Inside the guest

- [Execution pipeline](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/inside-the-guest/execution-pipeline): A block goes from witness to guest execution to public values, and the proof ties them to one ELF.
- [Witness formats](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/inside-the-guest/witness-formats): Guests read MFBD bundles, SSZ statelessInputBytes or EJSN test fixtures, and host tools produce each one.
- [Precompiles and syscalls](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/inside-the-guest/precompiles-and-syscalls): Guests hand keccak, curve and big-integer work to SP1 ecalls or to Airbender and ZisK CSR precompiles.
- [Proof guarantees](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/inside-the-guest/proof-guarantees): Each guest commits a fixed public-values layout, and each host checks it to a different degree.

## Testing

- [Execution spec tests](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/testing/execution-spec-tests): Zilkworm runs the Ethereum execution spec tests natively and under the Hypercube and Airbender guests.
- [RISC-V tests under QEMU](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/testing/riscv-tests-under-qemu): The execution spec tests also run on rv32im and rv64im builds under QEMU.
- [ERE validation](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/testing/ere-validation): The HashState guest runs in ERE to check outputs against fixtures and estimate SP1 proving cost.

## Reference

- [CLI reference](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/reference/cli-reference): Look up the flags, subcommands and exit codes of z6m_prover, z6m_prover_airbender and state_transition.
- [Releases and assets](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/reference/releases-and-assets): Each release ships host binaries, guest images and verification keys, with its measured results.
- [Building from source](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/reference/building-from-source): Build the guests, host provers and native tools from source and run the unit tests.
- [Benchmarks and CI](https://zilkworm.erigon.tech/reference/benchmarks-and-ci): GitHub workflows run the unit tests, EEST suites and 200-block benchmarks for the Hypercube and Airbender guests.
